$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: All buttons use text labels (Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Danger, Saving…, Not available) to identify themselves. While color distinguishes variants, it is not the sole means of conveying meaning.
All Variants: button fills and text have adequate contrast in light and dark modes. Loading and Disabled stories: disabled controls are exempt from 1.4.11.
Visible text matches screen reader announcements in all stories: Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Danger, Saving…, Not available.
All button text is fully visible with no truncation or overlap.
All Variants focused screenshot: Primary button has a clear blue focus ring; disabled stories have no focus screenshot (controls don't take focus).
